actions.name: sendLogs
actions.description: Send a single log to Coralogix Log Ingestion API.

actions.name: listIncidents
actions.description: Retrieve a filtered list of Coralogix incidents.

actions.name: acknowledgeIncidents
actions.description: Acknowledge one or more Coralogix incidents by incident ID.

actions.name: resolveIncidents
actions.description: Mark one or more Coralogix incidents as resolved.

actions.name: closeIncidents
actions.description: Close one or more Coralogix incidents (e.g. false positives or noise). Use Resolve for incidents that were actually fixed.

actions.name: assignIncidents
actions.description: Assign one or more Coralogix incidents to a specific user.

actions.name: getIncidentById
actions.description: Retrieve a Coralogix incident by its incident ID.

actions.name: getIncidentEvents
actions.description: Get related events for a specific incident.

actions.name: setAlertActive
actions.description: Enable or disable a Coralogix alert definition. Use this to mute alerts during maintenance windows.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: newAlertEvent
triggers.description: Triggers when Coralogix sends an alert-event webhook payload to this flow.

triggers.name: newIncident
triggers.description: Triggers when a new incident appears in Coralogix. Polls on a schedule — ideal for paging on-call, creating Jira tickets, or posting to Slack.
